symbols.name: scalar field
symbols.meaning: The field of scalars over which vector spaces are taken.
symbols.quote: Let $F$ be a field, the set of scalars.

symbols.name: vector space
symbols.meaning: The vector space of vectors under consideration, over the field F.
symbols.quote: A vector space over $F$ is a set $V$ of vectors with an addition and with multiplication by scalars from $F$, obeying the usual rules.

symbols.name: vector
symbols.quote: For vectors $u,v$ in $V$ and a scalar $a$ in $F$, one such rule is $a(u+v)=au+av$.

symbols.name: vector
symbols.quote: For vectors $u,v$ in $V$ and a scalar $a$ in $F$, one such rule is $a(u+v)=au+av$.

symbols.name: scalar
symbols.quote: For vectors $u,v$ in $V$ and a scalar $a$ in $F$, one such rule is $a(u+v)=au+av$.

symbols.name: linear map
symbols.meaning: A linear map of V into itself, the map whose rank and invertibility are discussed.
symbols.quote: A linear map $T\colon V\to V$ is a map of $V$ into itself with $T(u+v)=T(u)+T(v)$ and $T(au)=aT(u)$.

symbols.name: inverse map
symbols.meaning: The linear map that inverts T, when T is invertible.
symbols.quote: The map $T$ is invertible when some linear map $S\colon V\to V$ satisfies $ST=TS=\mathrm{id}$, the identity map; such an $S$ is the inverse, written $T^{-1}$.
